title: A measure with flat tangent measures a.e. is carried by a countably m-rectifiable set (Simon Ch. 3, 1.6 ⇐)
statement: Let m ≥ 1, let D ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} be open, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^{m+1} with μ(ℝ^{m+1} \ D) = 0 and μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ D, and ν : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m+1} Borel with |ν(y)| = 1 for every y. Assume that for μ-a.e. y and every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ, r^{-m} ∫ f(r^{-1}(z − y)) dμ(z) → ∫_{(span{ν(y)})^⊥} f dH^m as r ↓ 0 (H^m = μHE[m]). Then there is a Borel countably m-rectifiable set R ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} with μ(ℝ^{m+1} \ R) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), 1 ≤ m → IsOpen D → μ Dᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μ K ≠ ∞) → Measurable ν → (∀ y, ‖ν y‖ = 1) → (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ∀ f : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ m)⁻¹ * ∫ z, f (r⁻¹ • (z - y)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ z in ((Submodule.span ℝ {ν y})ᗮ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), f z ∂μHE[m]))) → ∃ R : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), MeasurableSet R ∧ CountablyRectifiable m R ∧ μ Rᶜ = 0
